author: ojiudezue
title: v5.100.5 shipped: Stop registering the dead React dashboards to the sidebar (reversible phase 1)
summary: Stop registering the dead React dashboards to the sidebar (reversible phase 1)
why: Operator directed deleting the dead React/WebSocket dashboards (never worked; URA moved to v8 Lovelace; PWA is a separate off-repo commercialization project). On reflection the operator asked for the SMALLER reversible change first: stop auto-deploying them to the sidebar, then delete the code later. Verified the cascade (deletion is not a plain rm): __init__ registers both panels + static paths with paired teardowns (4131-4214), deploy.sh:198 ships frontend/, and 5 setup-symmetry tests assert the registration. Phase 1 removes only the registration (reversible) and flips the tests to guard non-registration; phase 2 (irreversible code deletion) is parked behind a soak trigger. Grounded in the documented pivot HA-panel->PWA (BACKLOG.md:710) + the React dashboard's never-worked history (DASHBOARD_BACKLOG.md: hakit iframe #304).
implications: Shipped DELETE-REACT-DASHBOARDS-1 at v5.100.5; card(s) sit shipped_organic pending validation. Acceptance in README_v5.100.5.md (Live criteria).
revisit_trigger: HA sidebar no longer shows the two URA React panels (URA / URA Dashboard) after restart; integration setup completes with no 'Failed to register URA Dashboard panel' warnings; URA v8 Lovelace unaffected

refs.release_notes: Remove the __init__ panel + static-path registration for both frontend/ (ura-dashboard) and frontend-v3/ (ura-dashboard-v3) React dashboards - they never worked and are superseded by URA v8 Lovelace (PWA is off-repo). Reversible: code retained on disk, only the sidebar registration removed. 5 setup/unload-symmetry tests flipped from panel-registered-and-paired to panels-NOT-registered guards. Phase 2 (delete dirs + deploy.sh frontend line) parked as DELETE-REACT-DASHBOARDS-CODE-2.
